author: Axiom II
title: CPS_v1 Final v5 — Recursive ingest of CPS_v1 beacons; compute A2′, D1–D3, R2′ ratios
abstract: Recursively scan storage for CPS_v1 beacons (json/jsonl), extract Zephyr IV records, and compute A2′, D1–D3, R2′ deltas and Dk/R2′ ratios vs 2.5. Prints found file paths and phases for debugging. Read-only.
